nodes.title: LTX 2.5 NATIVE AUDIO — cómo está conectado
widgets_values:
# LTX 2.5 NATIVE AUDIO — this copy only

This workflow keeps the original FLF2V A/V sampler, First Frame, Last Frame, prompt enhancer, duration, resolution, frame rate, UNet, Gemma, video VAE and VRAM settings.

## Controls

- **GENERATE AUDIO (native LTX)**: OFF selects a dedicated guider that sets run_ax/run_a2v/run_v2a false before sampling, so LTX runs video-only; ON selects the original LTXV Dual CFG Guider unchanged. ON runs the native audio stream and routes it to `CreateVideo.audio`.
- **VISUAL PROMPT**: original FLF2V prompt, preserved as the default.
- **AUDIO PROMPT**: appended to the visual prompt only when audio is ON. LTX 2.5 does not expose an independent audio-text prompt in this ComfyUI graph; both streams receive the combined native text conditioning.
- **AUDIO GUIDANCE (CFG)**: connected to `LTXVDualCFGGuider.audio_cfg`; the video CFG remains unchanged.
- **AUDIO VOLUME (dB)**: post-decode adjustment; 0 means unchanged.

## Native chain

`LTXVEmptyLatentAudio` → `LTXVAudioGate` → joint LTX A/V diffusion. With OFF the gate provides zero audio tokens, so only the video path runs; with ON the chain continues through `LTXVSeparateAVLatent` → `LTXVAudioVAEDecode` → `AudioAdjustVolume` → `CreateVideo.audio`.

The audio VAE is a decoder/encoder for audio latents; the LTX transformer is what generates the audio latent. No AudioCraft, Stable Audio, external WAV generator or extra audio model is used.

## Outputs

- `final_native_audio_####.mp4`: selected output; audio is present when ON.
- `silent_original_####.mp4`: the original video-only branch, kept for debug.

The OFF branch is deliberately kept as the original `CreateVideo` path.

nodes.title: Note: About LTX-2.5
widgets_values:
# LTX-2.5

LTX-2.5 is Lightricks' open video generation model : fast, local-first, and built for production. Run it locally, fine-tune it for your own use case, or integrate it into your pipeline.

**Key highlights:**

- **Pixel Diffusion** : keyframes-first generation that builds every scene on a grid of high-fidelity keyframes for industry-leading pixel quality
- **Diffusion Video Decoder** : sharper faces, legible text, fewer smears in fast motion
- **Native multishot** : one generation yields multiple connected shots holding character, environment, lighting, voice, and style across cuts
- **Custom Gemma 4 12B text encoder** : retains multiple subjects, actions, lighting, detail, and camera direction across complex prompts
- **Dedicated Prompt Enhancer** *(optional)* : a lightweight model that expands short prompts into rich cinematic instructions
- **Auto Duration** : predicts the right clip length from the described action before diffusion begins
- **Better distilled model** : carries far more quality, prompt adherence, and motion into a smaller, faster variant
- Carried over from LTX-2.3: native 4K, synchronized audio-video

Official model & files: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5
## What this workflow does

This **First & Last Frame** workflow interpolates between two images. Load a first and a last frame, and the model generates the connected shots in between : holding character, environment, lighting, and style across the transition, with synchronized audio.

## Subgraph parameters

The **First & Last Frame to Video (LTX-2.5)** node is a subgraph. Click the **Enter subgraph** button at the bottom of the node to open its internal graph, where you can inspect and fine-tune every step of the pipeline (conditioning, sampler, CFG guider, VAE decode, and more).

| Parameter | What it does |
|---|---|
| first_frame | Starting image of the transition (load your own image in **Load First Frame**) |
| last_frame | Ending image of the transition (load your own image in **Load Last Frame**) |
| prompt | Text prompt describing the motion, scene, lighting, camera, and style |
| prompt_enhance | *(Optional, off by default)* Toggle the built-in Prompt Enhancer, which expands short prompts into rich cinematic instructions. Requires the separate prompt enhancer model (~10 GB) below and adds ~1-2 min of generation time |
| duration | Clip length in seconds (Auto Duration can predict it from the action) |
| width / height | Output resolution in pixels (e.g. 1280×720) |
| seed | Random seed : set a fixed value to reproduce the same result |
| frame_rate | Frames per second |
| unet_name | Main model: LTX-2.5 distilled transformer (ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) |
| video_vae | Video VAE used for decoding (ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) |
| audio_vae | Audio VAE that produces synchronized audio (ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors) |
| clip_name | Text encoder: custom Gemma 4 12B with projection (gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) |
| prompt_enhance_model | Model checkpoint used by the Prompt Enhancer |

## How to use

1. Download the models listed in **Note: Model Links** and place them in ComfyUI's `models/` folder (the prompt enhancer model is optional - skip it unless you enable **prompt_enhance**)
2. Replace the images in **Load First Frame** and **Load Last Frame** with your own start/end frames
3. Write a prompt describing the transition, optionally toggle **prompt_enhance** for short prompts
4. Set **duration** / **width** / **height** / **frame_rate** (defaults work well) and hit **Queue**
5. To dive deeper, click **Enter subgraph** at the bottom of the main node : every internal step (conditioning, sampler, CFG, VAE decode) can be edited there

nodes.title: AUDIO PROMPT (native joint conditioning)
widgets_values:
Deep male transformation scream with extreme effort and increasing intensity throughout the full 10-second sequence. Starts with heavy controlled breathing, low growls and restrained vocal strain, then builds into a powerful sustained scream as the energy rises. The scream becomes progressively louder, rougher and more aggressive without stopping abruptly.

Strong electrical crackling surrounds the body, with deep low-frequency energy rumble, vibrating air, rising wind and resonant power-up tones. The sound should feel concentrated around the body and expanding outward, without any landing sound, ground impact sound or physical collision.

During the middle of the transformation, the sustained scream reaches a much higher intensity while the electrical energy, wind and low-frequency resonance continue building.

In the final phase, the scream reaches an extreme sustained climax with massive energy resonance, intense electrical discharges, powerful wind, deep sub-bass vibration and a huge final sonic surge as the transformation into level 3 completes.

Realistic cinematic sound design, powerful male voice, natural breathing and vocal strain, synchronized with the visual transformation, strong spatial depth, no dialogue, no spoken words, no music, no singing, no footsteps, no landing sound, no ground impact sound.

nodes.title: VISUAL PROMPT (original FLF2V prompt)
widgets_values:
Transformación continua, realista y cinematográfica durante 10 segundos entre el primer y el último fotograma, pasando de Super Saiyan God a Super Saiyan Blue.

El mismo personaje debe mantenerse perfectamente reconocible durante toda la secuencia, conservando exactamente su identidad, rostro, cuerpo, ropa, proporciones, fondo, composición y posición en pantalla. Mantener el mismo escenario de montaña nevada, el mismo encuadre y el mismo ángulo de cámara durante toda la secuencia.

El personaje comienza en estado God: cabello rojo, aura roja intensa y el suelo ya muy destruido alrededor de sus pies. Está firmemente apoyado en el suelo durante toda la secuencia, con postura poderosa, estable y natural. No levita en ningún momento.

Desde el inicio, la energía vuelve a escalar. El personaje mantiene máxima concentración, puños cerrados, torso firme, cabeza estable y una expresión intensa pero realista.

Muy importante: durante el grito o la tensión vocal, la boca puede abrirse, pero solo de forma moderada, natural y anatómicamente correcta. La mandíbula no debe abrirse en exceso. El gesto debe transmitir potencia, no deformidad.

La transición principal ocurre en el cabello y el aura. El pelo rojo cambia progresivamente a azul brillante, manteniendo una forma compacta y poderosa. El aura roja se transforma poco a poco en un aura azul eléctrica, mucho más agresiva y vibrante, con rayos azules y blancos claramente visibles.

La energía debe sentirse más fría, eléctrica y brutal. El viento aumenta, la nieve se desplaza y la presión del poder se vuelve extrema. La silueta del personaje debe permanecer clara y el aura no debe tapar completamente el cuerpo ni el rostro.

La destrucción del suelo ya existente debe mantenerse y aumentar todavía más. Las grietas se expanden, el terreno se rompe aún más y la nieve y pequeñas rocas siguen desplazándose por la presión de la energía.

La secuencia termina exactamente en el estado final: cabello azul brillante, aura azul eléctrica muy intensa, rayos azules y blancos, máxima presión visual y el suelo en su punto de destrucción más avanzado.
